scope: All 32 restored T cases and all20 D201-D220 case bodies read; baseline immutable. Reused scheduling/control/API primitives earn zero additional credit.

case_audit.mechanism: Conditional native UPDATE affects one quota row only when capacity remains; that receipt controls SQL allocation and KV document/index creation.
case_audit.distinctness: T001/T031 supply reused ordering controls; D214 unconditionally inserts two RETURNING rows. New credit is bounded conditional mutation receipt governing a compound allocation.

case_audit.mechanism: Native UPSERT takes a first-insert then conflict-update path while preserving one BLOB and adding a second logical document.
case_audit.distinctness: No baseline tests native UPSERT conflict-update plus shared payload reference accounting. BLOB conversion and transaction queue alone earn no credit.

case_audit.mechanism: Native INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE trigger bodies maintain both sides of a collection move while explicit KV indexes follow the same transaction.
case_audit.distinctness: D218 tests ingest parser boundaries and trigger row-count metadata. Here ordinary exec triggers maintain old/new relational aggregates across queued requests; sql.ingest is not used.

case_audit.mechanism: Native foreign keys cascade primary-key rename and later parent deletion into composite-key chunk rows; an unrelated document survives.
case_audit.distinctness: Existing deletion tests cover KV counts/rollback, not native ON UPDATE and ON DELETE cascade propagation through relational ownership.

case_audit.mechanism: A DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED cyclic document/head relationship is temporarily unresolved inside a valid transaction and completed by an awaited successful child savepoint.
case_audit.distinctness: Nested commit ownership is reused, not counted. New mechanism is valid deferred cyclic relational integrity across successful nested savepoints and cross-surface head state. No failing commit is attempted.

case_audit.mechanism: A partial UNIQUE index releases an archived slug and an UPSERT conflict target WHERE live=1 selects only the replacement active row.
case_audit.distinctness: Distinct from schema recompilation T024 and unconditional RETURNING D214. Native partial-index conflict selection preserves historical identities; it is not another quota UPDATE.

case_audit.mechanism: A finite prefix list selects a page whose rows move into SQL before bulk deletion and remaining-byte accounting; the next queued extraction must select the next disjoint page.
case_audit.distinctness: Those cases establish individual list bounds, deletion counts, rollback and microtask ordering. This candidate asserts a disjoint two-request destructive partition transfer with a fixed cross-store conservation oracle; reviewer may withhold credit if judged redundant.

case_audit.mechanism: Native recursive CTEs derive materialized ancestry after a subtree move; a queued insert uses the new graph and all ancestor rollups must agree.
case_audit.distinctness: T030 runs an unrelated fixed 64x64 arithmetic query. This is a native recursive traversal feeding INSERT with relational membership and aggregate consistency, never a scalability or liveness benchmark.

case_audit.mechanism: Native row_number partitioning selects obsolete unpinned versions for DELETE RETURNING while preserving each document current pointer and byte total.
case_audit.distinctness: New native window-function partitioning plus conditional row deletion, distinct from unconditional INSERT RETURNING and restored KV rollback. Repeated left/right actions form one case, not two credits.

case_audit.mechanism: Finite byte-range read/modify/write spans two native BLOB rows; the later request overwrites only its overlap and leaves allocation/size unchanged.
case_audit.distinctness: Typed bind conversion is a reused prerequisite. New oracle is an exact multi-row overlapping range merge with preserved bytes and zero-growth accounting, not alias/snapshot ownership.

case_audit.mechanism: Native LAG of predecessor end offsets detects the exact hole between disjoint BLOB extents; queued gap-fill removes that gap while changing physical bytes without changing logical EOF.
case_audit.distinctness: T210 overwrites existing fixed chunks. This native LAG predecessor-boundary query discovers an actual extent gap and proves its removal after fill; fixture zero-fill earns no independent credit. T209 ranks whole revision rows for retention, whereas this case computes interval adjacency from BLOB lengths and offsets.

case_audit.mechanism: Native DELETE removes tail extents and substr clips a crossing BLOB; a queued append fills that partial chunk then creates a new one.
case_audit.distinctness: Distinct native deletion plus BLOB truncation path, then partial terminal reuse; neither existing overwrite nor sparse gap-fill removes physical data or clips native BLOBs.

case_audit.mechanism: A native aggregate HAVING predicate validates contiguous fixed chunks before materializing a manifest and transferring reserved bytes into live bytes.
case_audit.distinctness: No new generic queue credit. Unlike conditional quota UPDATE, this admission is a multi-row relational completeness reduction with manifest creation and a two-bucket charge transfer.

case_audit.mechanism: Stored generated byte length and virtual character length recompute on text mutation; an index on generated bytes must agree with document accounting.
case_audit.distinctness: Basic text conversion and schema recompilation are reused. New mechanism is stored/virtual generated recomputation and native generated-column index maintenance during ordinary rewrites.

case_audit.mechanism: Native FTS5 virtual-table UPDATE removes old token postings and DELETE removes another document while KV documents and counts track the same transactions.
case_audit.distinctness: No FTS5 posting mutation case exists in T001–T032 or D201–D220. Ordinary virtual-table index maintenance is a separate native path from SQL triggers or cached schema statements.

not_authored_for_extra_credit: Folder/tag/index renamings with identical API paths
